**Summary**

I read Costco's latest 10-K (fiscal year ended 2024-09-01) and found improving fundamentals: total net sales of $254,453M (up from $242,290M in fiscal 2023), operating income of $9,285M (vs. $8,114M), net income of $7,367M (vs. $6,292M), diluted EPS of $16.56 (vs. $14.16), and operating cash flow of $11,339M — solid top-line growth, expanding margins, and a clean balance-sheet/liquidity commentary with no unusual legal or accounting red flags, which supported a buy. Checking the quote at $891.09 (bid $891.07 / ask $891.11), I placed a single buy limit order for 5 shares at $892.00, which filled at $892.00 — roughly $4,460 total, comfortably under the $5,000 per-order and $10,000 daily caps, and I did not transfer any funds out of the account. The key reported figures underlying the decision, cited in key_figures, were fiscal 2024 net income of $7,367M, revenue of $254,453M, operating income of $9,285M, diluted EPS of $16.56, and operating cash flow of $11,339M.
